notes: Research ruling recommendation (operator rules; bakeoff.md NOT changed). Question: is auditor independence about the model or the context? Answer from the literature: it is about the model (weights), not the context (session). A fresh instance of the same model is byte-identical weights and carries the same self/family preference bias; 'same model' in the literature already means 'same model type/weights', never session-to-session. Mechanism evidence: Panickssery 2024 (self-recognition is a weights capability, correlates with self-preference), Wataoka 2024 (bias tracks perplexity/familiarity, weights-level, persists on non-self text), Li 2025 (preference leakage: same-model 23.6% >> same-family same-series 8.9% > different-series 2.8%; judges can't recognize students' outputs yet still leak preference -> spurious style features), Spiliopoulou 2025 (family bias real in GPT/Claude, absent in Llama/Mistral, ~0.02 score units), Xu 2024 (self-refinement amplifies self-bias -> same-model self-review is not neutral). Caveats: Chen 2025 (much self-preference is legitimate), Roytburg 2026 (preprint: ~89.6% of measured self-preference is measurement artifact). Also: bakeoff.md §3.6 cites Zheng 2023 for FAMILY exclusion, but Zheng 2023 measures IDENTITY (self-enhancement) and is itself agnostic; family bias is measured by Spiliopoulou 2025 / Li 2025. RULING RECOMMENDATION: keep family exclusion for scored races (re-point citation to Spiliopoulou 2025 + Li 2025); relax for audits to 'different model, never same-model-fresh-instance' (same-family different-model auditor acceptable, same model never). Marked UNKNOWN: no paper directly tests fresh-context as a variable (inferred from mechanism); true magnitude contested post-Roytburg; audit-shaped verification tasks have no dedicated measurement. Local test cost: three bounded bakeoff runs (fresh-context A/B, seeded-defect audit set, three-grader family-magnitude) using existing tools/bakeoff.sh. Directives: inbox polled empty at claim + checkpoint + close (0 directives; no pause/amend/question/kill received).
